title: Drug-Drug Interaction Extraction from Biomedical Texts
description: Extract drug entities and classify drug-drug interactions from biomedical texts, based on SemEval-2013 Task 9 (Segura-Bedmar et al.). Annotators identify drug mentions by type and classify interaction relationships between drug pairs.
